title: Just for Fun | Spacious 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
h1: Just for Fun Main and Carriage
meta_description: Just for Fun is a renovated, pet-friendly Seaside retreat with a private carriage house, watchtower, Gulf views, bikes, and steps to the beach and pools.
description_expanded: This beautiful corner unit home is the best of location and design. When you step inside, you are reminded of the sleek styling of a teak-trimmed sailboat. The second floor is open and airy, with brilliant natural light bathing the main living area and tall ceilings. All new plush furniture decorates the living room along with a large Smart TV and Sonos sound system. The home is recently updated, including all new bathrooms, an updated kitchen with white cabinetry and quartz countertops, and a new laundry room and powder room on the 2nd floor of the main house. The incredible private outdoor spaces include a rooftop sundeck and covered watchtower that offer 360-degree views of Seaside and the Gulf! You can feel the Gulf breeze as you rest on the bench or lather on the sunscreen to relax on the sundeck. This listing includes the well-appointed Carriage House, which offers all the same amenities of a larger Seaside home - two full baths, a full kitchen, in unit washer and dryer, living room, dining area, and outdoor dining on a private porch. You won't find anything else like this in Seaside! Just for Fun Main and Carriage House Features - Gulf Views from Top Floor Watchtower - Renovated for 2024! All new bathrooms, kitchen and laundry room - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - 2 Min Walk to Odessa Beach Entrance - access to private Seaside beaches included with your reservation. Please provide reservationist with total number of people in your party for passes. - Across from the Westside Pool - the largest pool in Seaside. Access included with your reservation. Towel service available subject to HOA policy. - Access to all Seaside Community Pools and Fitness Center included with your reservation. Schedule tennis lessons or rent court time on the Pickleball Courts - Complimentary use of 4 Taxi bikes - Smart TVs throughout home - Cable and Wi-Fi - Outdoor dining for 6 - Charcoal grill - Outdoor shower with privacy curtain - Covered front porch with rocking chairs - 2nd Floor Main living area with high ceilings and natural light - Covered balcony with outdoor dining tables, ceiling fans, and cushioned lounge chairs - 2nd Floor Kitchen with stainless steel appliances from Viking and Cuisinart - Top Floor Watchtower with 360 views of Seaside and the Gulf - Rooftop sundeck with cushioned loungers - 2nd Floor Laundry Room in the main house plus laundry closet in the carriage house - Parking for 2 vehicles -Concierge services including beach chair rentals, bike rentals, grocery delivery, and baby equipment rentals available - Golf cart rentals restricted in Seaside per the HOA (Medical exceptions may be granted on a limited basis) -Access to Seaside Beach private entrances and all Seaside community pools included with your reservation. Some pools heated during cooler months. Towel service available; subject to change by the HOA. - Access to Seaside Tennis and Fitness included with your reservation - Area summer camps and kids classes available - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee 4 Suites plus Loft Bedroom, 5 Full Baths and a Powder Room, Sleeps 13 - 1st Floor King Suite 1: closet and dresser storage, ceiling fan, TV, en suite bath with large soaking tub, and walk-in shower - 1st Floor King Suite 2: dresser and closet storage, ceiling fan, TV, en suite bath with walk-in shower - 3rd Floor Guest Suite: sleeping for 2 in Twin Beds, built-in dresser and closet, TV, en suite bath with walk-in shower and double sinks - Loft Room: 3rd Floor Loft in Main House with sleeping for 2 in twin beds, bed bag chairs, TV, ladder entrance to loft, curtains for privacy - Carriage House 2nd Floor Queen Suite: TV, private covered balcony with ceiling fan and lounge chairs, dresser storage, en suite bath with combination shower/tub. This suite encompasses the entire 2nd floor and there is no door shutting it off from the 1st floor. - Carriage House: Queen Sleeper Sofa in Carriage House, adjacent to Full Bath with walk-in shower, dresser storage, TV, private side porch with outdoor dining table - Bonus: twin air mattress which can be used on any level of the carriage house ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
